messages:
ida (Marketing): Uploaded the near-final draft. Need final hero headline, benchmark phrasing, gated webinar CTA, and HubSpot routing. Aim: soft launch Monday AM.
omar (Product): Quick read. I prefer concrete numbers: med/p95 deltas + a short test note. Avoid 'faster' in hero.
zoe (Growth): For CTAs: primary = 'Book a demo' for outbound signal, secondary = 'Download benchmark kit' gated. We'll route kit leads to nurture.
rashid (Design): Pushed a hero comp (console-snapshot-compact). Suggest headline: 'Lower p95, predictable service' and subline with med/p95 numbers.
ida (Marketing): Can we keep headline one short line mobile-first? Options: A) 'Predictable p95 for production' B) 'Lower p95, same quality' Thoughts?
omar (Product): B is better but tweak to 'Lower p95 at comparable quality'. I'll add a footnote about test harness (synth-load v2, 8GPU, seq1024).
zoe (Growth): Traffic split idea: 65% demo flow, 35% benchmark kit for first 72h. Also propose gating kit behind webinar registration.
marta (Growth Ops): HubSpot plan: lists = ["launch_demo_requests","launch_benchmark_kit"], utm_campaign=redwood-q2-launch. Form snippet I'll paste in the doc shortly. Leads with score>=60 go to SDR.
rashid (Design): Small copy ask: subhead should explicitly say 'real-world p95' rather than generic 'performance'. Updated mock in the doc.
ida (Marketing): Timeline: copy freeze 17:30 PT, design lock 18:00 PT, HS wired by 19:00 PT, preview build 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Any blockers?
omar (Product): I'll drop the appendix with precise numbers and the test note now.
zoe (Growth): I'll craft two CTA variants for the A/B and tracking tags. Also recommend a short gated asset: 3-slide recap + results.csv.
marta (Growth Ops): Form code posted in doc and lists created. I'll set autoresponders: kit -> PDF link, demo -> Calendly + follow-up.
preview-bot: staging preview scheduled for 2026-03-27T09:00:00Z for thread 5950001111
ida (Marketing): Thanks — I'll run a final editorial sweep after design lock and publish the preview. Ping here when you make doc edits. :seedling:
